entities.summary: Papyrus 15, signed by 𝔓15, is an early copy of the New Testament in Greek. It was originally a papyrus manuscript of the Pauline Corpus of letters, but now only contains 1 Corinthians 7:18–8:4. The manuscript has been palaeographically assigned to the 3rd century.
